instruction:
Create the file vault-data.js in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview defining the single global constant VAULT_DATA: an array of exactly eighty fictional note objects with the fields id, name, folder, tags and links. Each id is a unique lowercase slug; each name is a fictional note title; each folder is one of exactly six folder names with at least eight notes each; each tags field is an array of at most three lowercase tags; each links field is an array of note ids. Exactly eight notes are attachments whose names end in .png or .pdf; exactly five notes are orphans with an empty links field and no incoming link, and none of the five orphans is an attachment; exactly twelve link entries name an id that belongs to no note and are unresolved references, and those twelve entries use twelve distinct such ids; the total of all link entries is at least one hundred sixty; no note links to itself; every value is fictional and contains no real person, file or personal data.
Create the file graph-engine.js in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview defining a global GraphEngine object implementing a three-dimensional force-directed layout over a VAULT_DATA array. Its constructor takes no arguments and it exposes setParameter, getParameter, initialize, tick, pin, unpin, reheat, positions and alpha. The adjustable numeric parameters are exactly centerStrength, linkStrength, linkDistance, repelStrength, collideStrength, alphaDecay and velocityDecay, each with a working default value that getParameter returns by name. initialize takes the VAULT_DATA array and creates one node for every note, one ghost node for every distinct unresolved link target, and one tag node for every distinct tag, with one link from each note to each tag node matching its tags; it seeds distinct starting positions so no two nodes share a position, and records each node's link count. The simulation keeps one three-dimensional position, velocity and pinned flag per node; alpha starts at one; tick applies a center attraction toward the origin scaled by centerStrength, a spring force along every link toward its rest length linkDistance scaled by linkStrength, a mutual repulsion between every pair of nodes scaled by repelStrength, a separation preventing overlapping nodes scaled by collideStrength, integrates with damping by velocityDecay, decrements alpha by alphaDecay, and returns false without moving anything once alpha is below one one-hundredth; reheat sets alpha back to one; pin takes a node id and three coordinates and fixes that node at them until unpin frees it; pinned nodes never move; positions returns one record per node, each with the fields id, x, y, z, links, pinned, ghost and tag, where ghost and tag are true exactly for ghost nodes and tag nodes. The file uses no imports and never touches document, window or the network.
Create the file graph-render.js in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview defining a global GraphRender object that draws a GraphEngine layout with WebGL2. Its constructor takes the WebGL canvas, a transparent overlay canvas of the same size for text, the engine and the VAULT_DATA array, and it exposes frame, pick, unproject, focus, clearFocus, setOption, getOption and onHover. The camera orbits the origin with rotation, zoom distance and pan. The frame method renders exactly one step and returns immediately: when the animate option is on it first calls the engine's tick, then it draws each node as a shaded sphere whose radius grows with the node's link count and whose color is one of exactly six fixed colors chosen by the note's folder, each link as a straight line between its two nodes, each ghost node as a smaller hollow circle, each tag node as a small hollow diamond with its tag name, and a depth fog that darkens distant nodes and links toward the background color; it then draws each node's name on the overlay canvas as screen-space text whose opacity fades to zero between twice and half the text fade threshold relative to camera distance. setOption accepts exactly the options arrows, nodeSize, textFadeThreshold, animate, labels, highlight, focusDepth, and the four filter switches attachments, unresolved, orphans and tags, and getOption returns each by name: arrows draws a small cone at the target end of every link line; nodeSize scales every sphere radius; textFadeThreshold sets the label fade distance; labels shows or hides all name text; highlight takes one node id, several node ids or none, and lights those nodes, their direct neighbors and their links while dimming all other nodes and links; focusDepth limits the visible subgraph to at most that many link hops around the focused node, with zero meaning no restriction; the attachments switch hides or shows attachment notes, the unresolved switch hides or shows ghost nodes, the orphans switch hides or shows orphan notes, and the tags switch hides or shows tag nodes, each together with their links. pick returns the node id under given canvas coordinates or none; unproject returns the three-dimensional point on the plane through the origin facing the camera under given canvas coordinates; focus names the focused node and clearFocus removes the focus; onHover registers a callback that receives the hovered node id or none whenever it changes. The file uses no imports and makes no network request.
Create the file graph-input.js in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview defining the single global function attachGraphInput(canvas, renderer, engine) with no return value. Dragging with the primary button on empty space rotates the camera; dragging with the secondary button pans it; the wheel zooms within a fixed zoom range; dragging a node picked by the renderer pins it with the engine's pin at the three-dimensional point returned by the renderer's unproject under the pointer, moves the pin to follow the pointer during the drag, calls the engine's reheat once at drag start, and unpins the node on release; clicking a node without dragging focuses it; double-clicking empty space resets the view and clears the focus; pointer movement picks the hovered node and reports it through the renderer's onHover callback. Touch input maps one finger to rotate or node drag and two fingers to zoom and pan. The file uses no imports and makes no network request.
Create the file graph-ui.js in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview defining the single global function mountGraphUI(container, renderer, engine, data) that inserts into the given container a settings panel titled Graph settings. The panel contains an Animation toggle bound to the renderer option animate, an Arrows toggle bound to arrows, a Labels toggle bound to labels, a Node size slider bound to nodeSize, a Text fade threshold slider bound to textFadeThreshold, a Focus depth slider bound to focusDepth, the five force sliders Center force, Link force, Link distance, Repel force and Collision bound to the engine parameters centerStrength, linkStrength, linkDistance, repelStrength and collideStrength, a search field whose matches on note names and tags are passed to the renderer highlight option as the matching node ids with none when the field is empty, and the four filter toggles Attachments, Unresolved, Orphans and Tags bound to the four renderer filter switches. Every control reads its initial value with getOption or getParameter, shows its current value next to itself, updates its bound option or parameter immediately, and every force slider change also calls the engine's reheat. The file uses no imports and makes no network request.
Create the file index.html in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview with the title Symblic Graph View, a dark theme, a full-viewport WebGL canvas with the id graph-canvas, a transparent overlay canvas of the same size with the id label-canvas, a settings container with the id settings-panel, and a small footer crediting the Symblic beta. It loads exactly the files vault-data.js, graph-engine.js, graph-render.js, graph-input.js and graph-ui.js in that order, then constructs GraphEngine, calls its initialize with the VAULT_DATA array, constructs GraphRender with the graph-canvas element, the label-canvas element, the engine and the VAULT_DATA array, calls attachGraphInput with the graph-canvas element, the renderer and the engine, calls mountGraphUI with the settings-panel element, the renderer, the engine and the VAULT_DATA array, and starts a requestAnimationFrame loop that calls the renderer's frame method once per animation frame. It references no external resource and opens correctly from a plain static file path.
Run node --check in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview on exactly the five files vault-data.js, graph-engine.js, graph-render.js, graph-input.js and graph-ui.js and create the file verify.txt in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview with exactly five lines, each in the format filename: pass or filename: followed by the exact error message.
Create the file README.md in the folder /srv/symblic/projects/beta-graphview with three parts: the exact way to open the app, the list of every implemented feature naming the file that implements it, and a statement that the note dataset is fictional.
